status_summary: HUD has unwound several climate-related measures since 2025. A notice published 2025-06-26 ended the reduced green and energy-efficient premium category for Section 232 healthcare loans effective 2025-08-25, and a notice published 2025-09-23 set a single 0.25 percent premium for FHA multifamily programs and removed the 2016 premium categories for applications from 2025-10-01. After a 2025-07-07 request for comment, HUD and USDA rescinded the 2024 energy code determination for HUD- and USDA-financed new construction in a notice published 2026-05-01, following Executive Order 14394 (published 2026-03-18), which directed reform of such energy requirements. Notice H 2026-01 (issued 2026-01-26) restructured the Green and Resilient Retrofit Program and ended new funding for solar panels and EV chargers from 2026-03-01, and a proposed rule published 2026-07-10 would rescind most of the 2024 floodplain rule, with comments due 2026-09-08.

timeline.event: HUD published a notice ending the green and energy-efficient premium category for Section 232 mortgages, effective for applications received on or after 2025-08-25.
HUD and USDA published a notice seeking comment on revisiting adoption of the 2021 IECC and ASHRAE 90.1-2019 energy codes.
HUD finalized a single 0.25 percent premium for FHA multifamily programs and removed the 2016 premium rate categories, for applications from 2025-10-01.
HUD issued Notice H 2026-01 restructuring the Green and Resilient Retrofit Program, effective 2026-03-01.
Executive Order 14394 was published, directing HUD, USDA, DOE and FHFA to reform energy-efficiency and related requirements for housing.
HUD and USDA published a notice rescinding the 2024 final determination adopting energy efficiency standards for new HUD- and USDA-financed housing, effective the same day.
HUD proposed rescinding most of the 2024 floodplain management and wetlands rule, including its climate-informed science approach.

title: Repeal HUD climate change initiatives and related spending
